text:
incident-bot: ALERT: High 502/504 rates for customer AurigaEdge in private VPC (us-west-2). Symptoms: ALB healthcheck failures, outbound egress errors, packet retransmits observed. Pager sent to #incidents-primary.

jess (oncall): ACK. I'm on it. Initial customer-facing impact: some inference requests failing with 502s, estimated ~30% of requests to dedicated pool. Tagging netops. @miguel can you look at NATGW / conntrack?

miguel (netops): I'm pulling conntrack counts now. Can someone paste the exact times for spikes?

jess (oncall): Spike started ~1750502000, still ongoing.

samira (sre): Quick checklist: conntrack exhaustion or MSS/MTU issues often for heavy outbound streaming. If conntrack high, we can bump nf_conntrack_max and rotate NATGW. If MSS/clamp needed, iptables TCPMSS clamp on the gateway helps for fragmented flows.

miguel (netops): Running: `sudo conntrack -L | wc -l` -> 198,432 (current nf_conntrack_max=196608). That's the problem.

ashley (support): Customer reported degraded response times and some requests hitting timeouts. They're on a hard SLA — need ETA and mitigation note for support message.

samira (sre): Immediate mitigations (short lived):
- Increase conntrack_max to 262144: `sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144` (apply on all NATGW instances).
- Add TCPMSS clamp on NATGW: `iptables -t mangle -A POSTROUTING -p tcp --tcp-flags SYN,RST SYN -j TCPMSS --clamp-mss-to-pmtu`
- Drain and restart one NATGW at a time to free stale tuples.

miguel (netops): Applying sysctl on natgw-az-a-1: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144` -> accepted. Will apply across fleet via SSM in next 2 min.

miguel (netops): Adding TCPMSS rule on natgw-az-a-1 now.

samira (sre): Also check kernel conntrack timeouts: `sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established` — if long, consider reducing temporarily.

miguel (netops): After boosts + mangle rule on two NATGWs: conntrack count dropped to 120k. ALB healthchecks returning healthy again for a subset of targets.

jess (oncall): Good. Ashley, tell customer we've applied temporary mitigations (conntrack bump + MSS clamp) and are doing rolling NATGW restarts. Estimated full recovery in 15-30m, will follow up with a postmortem and durable solution. :white_check_mark:

ashley (support): Noted. Sending message to AurigaEdge with the steps and ETA now.

samira (sre): Follow-ups for durable fix:
- Add conntrack autosizing monitoring with alert at 70% of max.
- Harden NATGW AMI with TCPMSS rule baked in or use managed NLB path with TCP MSS handling.
- Evaluate offloading heavy outbound streaming to dedicated egress proxies to reduce per-NATGW tuple pressure.

miguel (netops): Creating a runbook entry and linking to this thread. Will add SSM document to apply MSS clamp and sysctl change safely.

jess (oncall): Handoff: I'm staying until service stable. If it regresses or customer impact persists, escalate to eng-networking. Otherwise, please post a summary and mark incident resolved when metrics normal for 30m.

incident-bot: Incident annotated: priority=sev2, customer=AurigaEdge (enterprise), affected=subset of private VPC tenants, remediation=conntrack increase + TCPMSS clamp + NATGW restarts.

miguel (netops): Summary (for ops):
- Cause: conntrack table exhaustion triggered by high concurrent outbound streams from tenant workload.
- Mitigation applied: increased nf_conntrack_max to 262144, applied TCPMSS clamp on NATGWs, rolling restart of NATGW instances to clear stale tuples.
- Status: ALB healthchecks stabilizing, 502 rate down from 32% -> 3% in 12 minutes.

ashley (support): Customer updated. They acknowledge and will watch. Asking for formal postmortem and timeline for permanent fix.

samira (sre): Assigning follow-ups: MIGUEL -> runbook + SSM doc; JESS -> coordinate PM for capacity/monitoring; ASHLEY -> customer postmortem draft.

jess (oncall): Thanks all. Leaving a note: consider adding an automated fallback to hosted inference pool in cases where private VPC egress capacity degrades. That will reduce customer-visible errors while remediation occurs.

miguel (netops): Runbook link: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/aurigaedge-vpc-conntrack (will update with commands and rollback steps).

jess (oncall): Marking thread for follow-up. Will close incident when metrics hold.

ashley (support): Closing customer loop once postmortem ready.

samira (sre): Good job team. :teamwork:
